note: Curated overlay for giver portraits (feature plan v7 F3), applied when the plugin builds its portrait index from the game art in the install (Tsukimichi.GameData/GiverPortraitSources.cs). crops: a family's typical face ({ eyes: [u, v], chin: v } in texture coordinates, framed by the one framing rule) or box ([u0, v0, u1, v1]) replacing the built-in default. iconCrops: one icon's face measured the same way, for art the family default frames badly. faces: a name (and era, the ExVersion row: 0 A Realm Reborn to 5 Dawntrail) for a face the game does not name, or a second name for a card drawn for one era. aliases: a source's spelling mapped to the name the givers carry. blocks: wrong matches kept out, by giver name or ENpcResident id (no icons: every portrait). pins: one giver id forced to one icon. Every entry needs a note; measure faces with `Tsukimichi.DataGen --portrait-sheet <dir> --game <sqpack> [--icons <ids>]`, whose sheets draw the eye-line and chin guides.
